target_definition.unit_or_option_space: below 0.293, within 0.293 to 0.401, or above 0.401 percent

graph_diagnosis.summary: The strict graph preserves quantitative-tightening, fiscal-liquidity, stabilization, and recent M2-momentum branches.
weaknesses: Several source articles were published after the April 1 forecast cutoff.
The graph mixes year-over-year M2 growth with the target monthly percentage change.
Direct links from February momentum and fiscal-inflation commentary to the April outcome overstate support.

search_factors.why_search: Balance-sheet runoff can restrain reserve and deposit growth.
Comparable month-to-month observations are the closest baseline for the April bucket.
Treasury flows, deposits, credit, and reserve demand can offset QT.
The registered bucket requires a monthly M2SL calculation, not a year-over-year proxy.

checkpoints.mechanism: Aggressive QT previously coincided with contraction in M2.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Use dated balance-sheet runoff and comparable M2 observations.

checkpoints.mechanism: Backing away from aggressive tightening can reduce the drag on money-supply growth.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Confirm the implemented runoff pace and reserve-balance path by the cutoff.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Runoff accelerates or reserves contract materially.

checkpoints.mechanism: Fiscal flows can support deposits and liquidity even while QT continues.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Measure Treasury cash flows, bank deposits, reserves, and credit rather than inferring from debt alone.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Debt issuance drains liquidity or deposits contract.

checkpoints.mechanism: Stabilization and recent monthly increases provide a baseline for the next monthly observation.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Recalculate sequential monthly M2SL changes on a consistent vintage.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: The latest monthly observation reverses or revisions remove the trend.

checkpoints.mechanism: Continued QT can limit upside in M2 growth even if the runoff pace moderates.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Use cutoff-compliant official runoff data; the cited April 15 article is post-cutoff.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: The balance sheet stabilizes or reserve growth accelerates.

checkpoints.mechanism: Map policy and liquidity signals to the registered bucket only with comparable monthly M2SL changes.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Compute April versus March M2SL on the same data vintage and compare with 0.293 and 0.401 percent.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Year-over-year acceleration disagrees with the month-to-month change.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: A slower QT drag can permit stabilization and moderate monthly M2 growth.
applicability_conditions: Comparable monthly M2 observations confirm momentum.
failure_conditions: Monthly M2 reverses despite year-over-year growth.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Fiscal and banking liquidity can reinforce M2 growth when deposits and reserves expand.
applicability_conditions: Fiscal flows increase deposits or reserves.
failure_conditions: Issuance drains liquidity or bank deposits decline.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Continued runoff can cap monthly M2 growth.
applicability_conditions: Runoff remains active and transmission to deposits persists.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Year-over-year M2 acceleration masks a weak April month-to-month change.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Compare the monthly and year-over-year M2SL calculations on one vintage.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Fiscal flows and deposit creation offset ongoing QT.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Measure Treasury flows, bank deposits, reserves, and credit alongside runoff.

forecast_audit_questions: Are all inputs available by the April 1 cutoff?
Are monthly and year-over-year M2 growth being kept distinct?
Do deposits and reserves corroborate the inferred policy transmission?
Was the target bucket computed from a consistent M2SL vintage?
